definition: a list of the topics to be discussed in a meeting
example: Please send the agenda before the meeting so everyone can prepare.
exampleEs: Por favor envía el orden del día antes de la reunión para que todos puedan prepararse.
cloze: Please send the ____ before the meeting so everyone can prepare.
note: Not a personal planner: in English, agenda is mostly the list of topics for a meeting.

definition: to take more action on something after an earlier conversation or message
example: I will follow up with the vendor about the missing invoice tomorrow.
exampleEs: Le daré seguimiento al proveedor sobre la factura faltante mañana.
cloze: I will ____ with the vendor about the missing invoice tomorrow.
note: The noun is written with a hyphen: a follow-up. Use 'follow up on' a topic, 'follow up with' a person.

definition: to arrange things or opinions so that they agree or work well together
example: We need to align our priorities with the goals of the whole department.
exampleEs: Necesitamos alinear nuestras prioridades con los objetivos de todo el departamento.
cloze: We need to ____ our priorities with the goals of the whole department.
note: Say 'align with' something, not 'align to' in most work contexts.

definition: a person or group that has an interest in a project or is affected by it
example: Every key stakeholder should review the plan before we start.
exampleEs: Cada parte interesada clave debería revisar el plan antes de empezar.
cloze: Every key ____ should review the plan before we start.
note: Not the same as shareholder (someone who owns shares in a company).

definition: the latest time or date by which something must be finished
example: The deadline for the report is Friday at five o'clock.
exampleEs: La fecha límite del informe es el viernes a las cinco.
cloze: The ____ for the report is Friday at five o'clock.
note: Use 'meet' or 'miss' a deadline, not 'complete' or 'lose' it.

definition: to finish a meeting or a task, often with a short summary
example: Let's wrap up and review the action items before we leave.
exampleEs: Vamos cerrando y revisemos los pendientes antes de irnos.
cloze: Let's ____ and review the action items before we leave.
note: 'To wrap up' also works as a signal near the end: 'To wrap up, here are our next steps.'

definition: a specific task that someone agrees to do after a meeting
example: My action item is to send the updated budget by Monday.
exampleEs: Mi tarea pendiente es enviar el presupuesto actualizado el lunes.
cloze: My ____ is to send the updated budget by Monday.
note: Usually plural in meetings: 'the action items'. Action here is a noun used like an adjective.

definition: a point in a process where work slows down because capacity is limited
example: The approval step is the main bottleneck in our release process.
exampleEs: El paso de aprobación es el principal cuello de botella en nuestro proceso de lanzamiento.
cloze: The approval step is the main ____ in our release process.
note: Spanish uses the same image: cuello de botella.

es: escalar, elevar a un nivel superior
definition: to pass a problem to someone with more authority
example: If the vendor does not reply today, I will escalate the issue to my manager.
exampleEs: Si el proveedor no responde hoy, escalaré el problema a mi gerente.
cloze: If the vendor does not reply today, I will ____ the issue to my manager.
note: Say 'escalate an issue to someone'. It is formal and neutral, not aggressive.

definition: a short meeting to share updates and stay coordinated
example: Let's have a quick sync tomorrow morning to check our progress.
exampleEs: Hagamos una sincronización rápida mañana en la mañana para revisar nuestro avance.
cloze: Let's have a quick ____ tomorrow morning to check our progress.
note: Pronounced /sɪŋk/, like 'sink'. It is also a verb: 'We sync every Monday.'

es: ponerse en contacto, ponerse al día brevemente
definition: to contact someone briefly to share news or check how things are going
example: I just wanted to touch base before the client call on Thursday.
exampleEs: Solo quería ponerme en contacto antes de la llamada con el cliente el jueves.
cloze: I just wanted to ____ before the client call on Thursday.
note: Always 'touch base with' a person. It comes from baseball.

es: estar de acuerdo, tener el mismo entendimiento
definition: sharing the same understanding of a situation or plan
example: Before we start, let's make sure we are all on the same page.
exampleEs: Antes de empezar, asegurémonos de que todos estamos en la misma sintonía.
cloze: Before we start, let's make sure we are all ____.
collocations: make sure we're on the same page
note: Do not say 'in the same page'. The preposition is on.

es: hacerse responsable, adueñarse de una tarea
definition: to accept full responsibility for a task or problem
example: Maria took ownership of the migration and finished it on time.
exampleEs: Maria se hizo responsable de la migración y la terminó a tiempo.
cloze: Maria ____ of the migration and finished it on time.
note: The structure is 'take ownership of' something. It is a positive thing to say about a colleague.

definition: to disagree with or resist a request or idea, politely or firmly
example: The team had to push back on the unrealistic deadline.
exampleEs: El equipo tuvo que oponerse a la fecha límite poco realista.
cloze: The team had to ____ on the unrealistic deadline.
note: Careful: 'push back' can also mean 'delay' (push back the meeting to Friday). Context shows which meaning.

definition: a rough estimate that is close enough to be useful
example: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the cloud costs?
exampleEs: ¿Me puedes dar una cifra aproximada de los costos de la nube?
cloze: Can you give me a ____ figure for the cloud costs?
note: Informal. 'What's the ballpark?' means 'roughly how much?'

definition: a product or document that must be delivered as part of a project
example: The main deliverable for this phase is a working prototype.
exampleEs: El entregable principal de esta fase es un prototipo funcional.
cloze: The main ____ for this phase is a working prototype.
note: Usually used in the plural in project plans: 'the deliverables'.

definition: an important point or event in the progress of a project
example: Finishing the pilot was a major milestone for the whole team.
exampleEs: Terminar el piloto fue un hito importante para todo el equipo.
cloze: Finishing the pilot was a major ____ for the whole team.
note: Spanish 'hito' is the best match. Do not translate it as 'landmark' in a project context.

definition: the time and energy a person or team has available to take on more work
example: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project this month.
exampleEs: No tengo la capacidad para tomar otro proyecto este mes.
cloze: I don't have the ____ to take on another project this month.
note: In tech it means network capacity, but at work it is a polite way to say you are too busy.

definition: to include someone in a conversation or email so they stay informed
example: I'll loop in the legal team so they can review the contract.
exampleEs: Voy a incluir al equipo legal para que revisen el contrato.
cloze: I'll ____ the legal team so they can review the contract.
note: Both orders work: 'loop in Ana' and 'loop Ana in'.

definition: to return to a topic or person later, after dealing with something else
example: We don't have the data yet, so let's circle back next week.
exampleEs: Todavía no tenemos los datos, así que retomemos esto la próxima semana.
cloze: We don't have the data yet, so let's ____ next week.
note: Say 'circle back to' a topic. It sounds natural but a little corporate.

definition: an early warning about something that is going to happen
example: Thanks for the heads-up about the schedule change.
exampleEs: Gracias por el aviso sobre el cambio de horario.
cloze: Thanks for the ____ about the schedule change.
note: Say 'give someone a heads-up' or 'thanks for the heads-up'. It is not a verb.

definition: a plan that shows what a team will do and in what order
example: The product roadmap includes three major features for next year.
exampleEs: La hoja de ruta del producto incluye tres funciones importantes para el próximo año.
cloze: The product ____ includes three major features for next year.
note: One word, no space. Spanish: hoja de ruta.

definition: the range of work or topics that a project includes
example: That request is outside the scope of this project.
exampleEs: Esa solicitud está fuera del alcance de este proyecto.
cloze: That request is outside the ____ of this project.
note: 'Scope creep' means the slow, unplanned growth of a project's work.

definition: to start a meeting, project or event
example: We will kick off the project with a short meeting on Monday.
exampleEs: Vamos a arrancar el proyecto con una reunión corta el lunes.
cloze: We will ____ the project with a short meeting on Monday.
note: The noun is 'kickoff' or 'kick-off': a kickoff meeting.

definition: to help a new employee or customer get started and learn how things work
example: We will onboard the new engineer during her first week.
exampleEs: Vamos a incorporar a la nueva ingeniera durante su primera semana.
cloze: We will ____ the new engineer during her first week.
note: The noun is 'onboarding'. The verb is often used for new hires.

definition: to decide which things are most important and do them first
example: We need to prioritize the bugs that affect customers.
exampleEs: Necesitamos priorizar los errores que afectan a los clientes.
cloze: We need to ____ the bugs that affect customers.
note: Spelled with a z in US English (prioritize) and usually s in British English.

definition: to give part of your work or authority to another person
example: A good manager knows when to delegate tasks to the team.
exampleEs: Un buen gerente sabe cuándo delegar tareas al equipo.
cloze: A good manager knows when to ____ tasks to the team.
note: As a verb it ends in /eɪt/ (del-uh-gate); as a noun it ends in /ət/.

definition: to make something easier to understand by giving more details
example: Could you clarify what you mean by the second requirement?
exampleEs: ¿Podrías aclarar qué quieres decir con el segundo requisito?
cloze: Could you ____ what you mean by the second requirement?
note: Use it to ask politely for more detail: 'Could you clarify...?'

definition: to move an event to a later time
example: We had to postpone the demo because the server was down.
exampleEs: Tuvimos que posponer la demostración porque el servidor estaba caído.
cloze: We had to ____ the demo because the server was down.
note: The verb takes a direct object: 'postpone the meeting', not 'postpone for the meeting'.

definition: to change the time or date of a planned event
example: Can we reschedule our one-on-one to Thursday afternoon?
exampleEs: ¿Podemos reprogramar nuestra reunión individual para el jueves en la tarde?
cloze: Can we ____ our one-on-one to Thursday afternoon?
note: Use 'reschedule to' a new time. In US English it sounds like 're-SKED-jool'.

definition: a person who goes to a meeting or event
example: Each attendee will receive a link to the recording.
exampleEs: Cada asistente recibirá un enlace a la grabación.
cloze: Each ____ will receive a link to the recording.
note: False friend risk: 'assist' means 'help' in English, not 'attend'. Use attendee or participant.

definition: a short summary of the main points that were discussed
example: Thanks for the recap, it helped me understand what I missed.
exampleEs: Gracias por el resumen, me ayudó a entender lo que me perdí.
cloze: Thanks for the ____, it helped me understand what I missed.
note: It is also a verb: 'Let me recap.' The noun is stressed on the first syllable, the verb on the second.

definition: the most important point to remember from a meeting or presentation
example: The main takeaway from the call is that we need more testing.
exampleEs: La conclusión principal de la llamada es que necesitamos más pruebas.
cloze: The main ____ from the call is that we need more testing.
note: In British English a takeaway is also takeout food, but in meetings it means a key lesson.

definition: agreement and support from people who are needed to make a plan work
example: We need buy-in from leadership before we change the process.
exampleEs: Necesitamos el apoyo de la dirección antes de cambiar el proceso.
cloze: We need ____ from leadership before we change the process.
note: Uncountable: say 'we need buy-in', not 'we need a buy-in'.

definition: a problem that stops you from continuing your work
example: My only blocker is that I still don't have access to the database.
exampleEs: Mi único impedimento es que todavía no tengo acceso a la base de datos.
cloze: My only ____ is that I still don't have access to the database.
note: In daily stand-ups people ask, 'Do you have any blockers?'

es: tiempo de entrega, tiempo de respuesta
definition: the time it takes to finish a piece of work after receiving it
example: The vendor promises a turnaround of two business days.
exampleEs: El proveedor promete un tiempo de entrega de dos días hábiles.
cloze: The vendor promises a ____ of two business days.
note: 'Quick turnaround' means the work gets done fast.

definition: to make a process simpler and more efficient
example: We want to streamline the approval process to save time.
exampleEs: Queremos agilizar el proceso de aprobación para ahorrar tiempo.
cloze: We want to ____ the approval process to save time.
note: A positive word. The opposite idea is 'complicate'.

definition: the amount of work that a person or team has to do
example: My workload has doubled since two colleagues left.
exampleEs: Mi carga de trabajo se duplicó desde que se fueron dos compañeros.
cloze: My ____ has doubled since two colleagues left.
note: Singular and uncountable: 'a heavy workload', not 'many workloads' (unless talking about servers).

definition: comments about someone's work that help them improve
example: I'd really appreciate your feedback on this draft.
exampleEs: Realmente agradecería tus comentarios sobre este borrador.
cloze: I'd really appreciate your ____ on this draft.
note: Uncountable: say 'some feedback', not 'a feedback' or 'feedbacks'. Use 'feedback on' something.

definition: a plan showing when things will happen
example: What is the timeline for the clinical data review?
exampleEs: ¿Cuál es el cronograma para la revisión de los datos clínicos?
cloze: What is the ____ for the clinical data review?
note: Say 'timeline for' a project. A timeline is a plan, a deadline is one final date.

definition: something that limits what you can do
example: Budget is the biggest constraint for this project.
exampleEs: El presupuesto es la mayor restricción de este proyecto.
cloze: Budget is the biggest ____ for this project.
note: Often plural: 'time constraints' or 'resource constraints'.

definition: a situation where you must give up one thing to get another
example: There is always a trade-off between speed and quality.
exampleEs: Siempre hay un equilibrio que sacrificar entre velocidad y calidad.
cloze: There is always a ____ between speed and quality.
note: Say 'a trade-off between A and B'. It is a noun, so the verb form is 'trade off'.

definition: to make something bad less serious or less harmful
example: We can mitigate the risk by testing the system first.
exampleEs: Podemos mitigar el riesgo probando primero el sistema.
cloze: We can ____ the risk by testing the system first.
note: Do not confuse with 'militate'. Mitigate works with risks, damage and problems.

definition: following the rules, laws and standards that apply to your work
example: The compliance team must approve every document before we share it.
exampleEs: El equipo de cumplimiento debe aprobar cada documento antes de compartirlo.
cloze: The ____ team must approve every document before we share it.
note: Say 'compliance with' a rule. It is very common in pharma and finance.

definition: an official check of records or processes to see if they are correct
example: We are preparing for the quality audit next month.
exampleEs: Nos estamos preparando para la auditoría de calidad del próximo mes.
cloze: We are preparing for the quality ____ next month.
note: Pronounced /ˈɔːdɪt/. It is also a verb: 'They audit our records every year.'

es: cartera de proyectos, flujo de trabajo
definition: a set of projects or tasks that are planned or in progress
example: We have three new drugs in the pipeline.
exampleEs: Tenemos tres medicamentos nuevos en desarrollo.
cloze: We have three new drugs in the ____.
note: 'In the pipeline' means something is being prepared. In pharma it means products under development.

definition: a standard used to compare how well something is performing
example: We use last year's results as a benchmark for this quarter.
exampleEs: Usamos los resultados del año pasado como punto de referencia para este trimestre.
cloze: We use last year's results as a ____ for this quarter.
note: It is also a verb: 'benchmark against competitors'.

definition: general agreement among a group of people
example: After a long discussion, we finally reached a consensus.
exampleEs: Después de una larga discusión, por fin llegamos a un consenso.
cloze: After a long discussion, we finally reached a ____.
note: Spelling: consensus, not 'concensus'. It already means general agreement, so 'consensus of opinion' is redundant.

definition: to contact someone, usually to ask for help or share information
example: Please reach out to me if you have any questions.
exampleEs: Por favor contáctame si tienes alguna pregunta.
cloze: Please ____ to me if you have any questions.
note: Always 'reach out to' a person, not 'reach out a person'.

definition: to give responsibility for a task or project to someone else
example: Before my vacation, I will hand over the project to Carlos.
exampleEs: Antes de mis vacaciones, voy a transferirle el proyecto a Carlos.
cloze: Before my vacation, I will ____ the project to Carlos.
note: The noun is 'handover' (one word): a handover document.

definition: to go over something quickly from beginning to end
example: Let me run through the main points before we take questions.
exampleEs: Déjame repasar los puntos principales antes de recibir preguntas.
cloze: Let me ____ the main points before we take questions.
note: The noun is 'run-through': a quick run-through of the slides.

definition: to join a discussion by adding a comment
example: Feel free to chime in if you disagree with anything.
exampleEs: Siéntete libre de intervenir si no estás de acuerdo con algo.
cloze: Feel free to ____ if you disagree with anything.
note: Friendly and informal. Say 'chime in on' a topic.

definition: to give your opinion in a discussion, especially on an important matter
example: I would like the security team to weigh in before we decide.
exampleEs: Me gustaría que el equipo de seguridad opine antes de decidir.
cloze: I would like the security team to ____ before we decide.
note: Use 'weigh in on' a topic. It suggests that the opinion carries weight.

definition: to look at the details of a topic or data more closely
example: Let's drill down into the numbers to see why sales dropped.
exampleEs: Profundicemos en los números para ver por qué bajaron las ventas.
cloze: Let's ____ into the numbers to see why sales dropped.
note: Say 'drill down into' or 'drill down on' a topic.

definition: to increase the amount or speed of something gradually
example: We plan to ramp up production in the second quarter.
exampleEs: Planeamos aumentar gradualmente la producción en el segundo trimestre.
cloze: We plan to ____ production in the second quarter.
note: The noun 'ramp-up' means the period when something grows.

es: dar aprobación final, firmar de conformidad
definition: to give final official approval of something
example: The director needs to sign off on the budget before we spend anything.
exampleEs: El director necesita dar su aprobación final al presupuesto antes de que gastemos algo.
cloze: The director needs to ____ on the budget before we spend anything.
note: Say 'sign off on' something. The noun is 'sign-off': we need your sign-off.

definition: to examine a problem or question to find out more
example: I'll look into the error and let you know what I find.
exampleEs: Voy a investigar el error y te aviso qué encuentro.
cloze: I'll ____ the error and let you know what I find.
note: A useful promise in meetings: 'I'll look into it.'

es: según lo planeado, en buen camino
definition: progressing as planned and likely to succeed
example: The project is on track to finish before the deadline.
exampleEs: El proyecto va por buen camino para terminar antes de la fecha límite.
cloze: The project is ____ to finish before the deadline.
note: Say 'on track to' plus a verb. The opposite is 'off track' or 'behind schedule'.

definition: to progress more slowly than planned or than other people
example: We fell behind schedule because the tests took longer than expected.
exampleEs: Nos retrasamos porque las pruebas tomaron más tiempo de lo esperado.
cloze: We ____ schedule because the tests took longer than expected.
note: Say 'behind schedule' or 'fall behind on' a task. Past tense is 'fell behind'.

definition: temporarily stopped, but expected to continue later
example: The launch is on hold until legal approves the contract.
exampleEs: El lanzamiento está en pausa hasta que legal apruebe el contrato.
cloze: The launch is ____ until legal approves the contract.
note: Also used on the phone: 'Please stay on hold.'

definition: informed about what is happening in a project or discussion
example: Please keep me in the loop as the plan changes.
exampleEs: Por favor mantenme al tanto mientras el plan cambia.
cloze: Please keep me ____ as the plan changes.
note: 'Out of the loop' is the opposite: not informed.

definition: from now on, or in the future
example: Moving forward, we will send a written summary after every meeting.
exampleEs: De ahora en adelante, enviaremos un resumen escrito después de cada reunión.
cloze: ____, we will send a written summary after every meeting.
note: Often used at the start of a sentence followed by a comma. 'Going forward' means the same.

definition: waiting to be decided or finished
example: The approval is still pending, so we cannot start yet.
exampleEs: La aprobación sigue pendiente, así que todavía no podemos empezar.
cloze: The approval is still ____, so we cannot start yet.
note: Common in forms: 'pending approval'. Spanish 'estar pendiente de' (to keep an eye on something) is not 'be pending'.

definition: not done or paid by the required time
example: This report is two weeks overdue and the client is asking about it.
exampleEs: Este informe lleva dos semanas de atraso y el cliente está preguntando por él.
cloze: This report is two weeks ____ and the client is asking about it.
note: Say 'two weeks overdue' after the verb. 'Long overdue' means something should have happened much earlier.

definition: the final result of a meeting, process or action
example: What is the desired outcome of this meeting?
exampleEs: ¿Cuál es el resultado deseado de esta reunión?
cloze: What is the desired ____ of this meeting?
note: Outcome is the result of an action; output is what is produced.

definition: to start talking about a subject
example: I didn't want to bring up the budget in front of the client.
exampleEs: No quería sacar el tema del presupuesto delante del cliente.
cloze: I didn't want to ____ the budget in front of the client.
collocations: bring it up in the meeting
note: Do not confuse with 'raise a child' (also bring up). In meetings it means mention.

definition: to postpone discussion of something until later (US usage)
example: Let's table this discussion until we have the final numbers.
exampleEs: Dejemos esta discusión para más tarde hasta tener las cifras finales.
cloze: Let's ____ this discussion until we have the final numbers.
note: Careful: in US English 'table' means postpone; in British English it means put forward for discussion.

definition: to think of many ideas quickly as a group
example: Let's brainstorm a few ways to reduce customer wait times.
exampleEs: Hagamos una lluvia de ideas sobre algunas formas de reducir los tiempos de espera de los clientes.
cloze: Let's ____ a few ways to reduce customer wait times.
note: It is a regular verb: brainstormed, brainstorming. Do not say 'make a brainstorm'.

definition: the actions that will be taken after a meeting or decision
example: Before we hang up, let's confirm the next steps.
exampleEs: Antes de colgar, confirmemos los siguientes pasos.
cloze: Before we hang up, let's confirm the ____.
note: Normally plural: 'the next steps'.

definition: the amount of work that a team or system can handle
example: We are at full capacity, so we cannot accept new requests.
exampleEs: Estamos a plena capacidad, así que no podemos aceptar solicitudes nuevas.
cloze: We are at full ____, so we cannot accept new requests.
note: Use 'at capacity' when nothing more fits. It is similar to bandwidth for people.
